name: The artefact is the front door
definition: Let strangers see the finished work before they sign up, and put the signup at the moment they want to keep it.

mechanism.summary: Users make things that are useful to other people, and those things are published where strangers find them, usually through search. They render fully without an account; keeping a copy requires one, so the artefact does the selling and the wall does the converting.

preconditions: The artefact is useful to someone who did not make it
It can be shown publicly, in full, without an account
Enough users make artefacts to cover many different search intents
failureModes: The artefact is fully useful without copying it, so nobody reaches the wall
The people who convert already had accounts, so the loop re-engages rather than acquires
Low-quality inventory floods the catalogue and erodes its search value

antiPattern.name: Gate the preview
antiPattern.description: Hiding the artefact behind a signup before the visitor has seen it asks for commitment before showing value. A front door reverses that order.

relationships.rationale: The artefact recruits individuals for free, and the paid boundary is waiting for them when they invite a colleague.
